hero.title: Evrideo, a cloud-based Broadcasting  software
hero.introHtml: SPARK worked with Evrideo to design and develop a new suite of products over 12 months. Through rapid prototyping and client testing, we helped them sell early—before full development—cutting dev costs by 50%. In 2025, after launching the new platform, Evrideo saw 600% growth in just two months.

Evrideo's value

Evrideo replaces traditional broadcast infrastructure with a fully cloud-based, end-to-end playout solution—eliminating the need for costly hardware, manual operations, and complex integrations.
